subject: general
question: Which countries are participating in the 4th edition of Exercise La Perouse in which INS Mumbai, an indigenously built destroyer, is also participating?

options.text: Australia, France, India, Germany, Japan, South Korea, USA, and U.K.
Australia, France, USA, U.K., India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Canada
France, USA, U.K., Germany, Singapore, Italy, Ukraine, Moldova and Canada
India, USA, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Cambodia, Philippines and Australia

solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia, France, USA, U.K., India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Canada.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **INS Mumbai, an indigenously built destroyer, is participating in the 4th edition of Exercise La Perouse.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Countries participating include India, Australia, France, USA, U.K., Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Canada.**
 
• Exercise focuses on maritime surveillance, air defense, and tactical interoperability.
 
• Includes complex multi-domain exercises for enhanced operational synergy.
 
• Aligns with India’s SAGAR vision for a secure Indo-Pacific region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• SAGAR Vision__

 __
 
• Security and Growth for All in the Region, India’s strategic initiative for maritime cooperation.
 
 
 
• Exercise La Perouse__
 __
 
• Multinational naval exercise aimed at enhancing tactical interoperability and maritime cooperation.
 
 
 
• INS Mumbai__
 
 
• An indigenously built guided missile destroyer of the Indian Navy.
